name: boundaryxp
description: 7+1 task boundary analysis, native calculation verification and evidence reports. Local stdio MCP for Windows x64; model API configured separately.

BXP_DATA_ROOT.title: Persistent data directory / 任务数据目录
BXP_DATA_ROOT.description: Absolute local directory. Keep the same path across upgrades; do not use another installation's data.

BXP_PROFILES_FILE.title: Profiles JSON file / 模型配置文件
BXP_PROFILES_FILE.description: Absolute path to your UTF-8 profiles.json. An empty profiles array permits read-only use. See docs/mcp/CURSOR-MARKETPLACE.md.

CURSOR_API_KEY.title: Cursor API key (optional)
CURSOR_API_KEY.description: For a Cursor API profile; independent of the host chat subscription.

BOUNDARYXP_API_BASE_URL.title: Compatible API base URL (optional)
BOUNDARYXP_API_BASE_URL.description: Chat Completions compatible endpoint, including /v1 where required.

BOUNDARYXP_API_KEY.title: Compatible API key (optional)
BOUNDARYXP_API_KEY.description: For the openai-compatible model profile. Do not put secrets in task text.
